name: Autumn Benitez
headline: Social @ Forbes | LinkedIn Creator | Speaker

sections.bio:
Hi there, I’m Autumn 👋🏼

I'm a LinkedIn creator passionate about helping people navigate the future of work, social media, and the creator economy. Drawing from my experience leading social strategy at Forbes, I break down industry trends, share behind-the-scenes insights, and create educational content that makes complex topics accessible and actionable.

My audience is made up of marketers, creators, entrepreneurs, students, and professionals who come to my content for practical advice, career insights, and an inside look at how leading brands and media companies approach social. I focus on creating authentic, story-driven content that sparks conversation while delivering value.

I partner with brands whose products and services genuinely support professionals, creators, and businesses, integrating them naturally into content that educates, informs, and inspires.

posts.text:
A very social night for people who spend all day on social 💚 

Had the best time at my second The Social Party, hosted by the amazing Grace Tully and Jo Pham at AirHQ...these two really know how to bring a group together!!

Summer nights + getting out from behind the screen + spending time with people who understand just how stressful (but also very fun) the world we work in can be? Please invite me every time.

AND swipe to the end to see the sweetest surprise guest of the night! 🐶

 📸 : Julia Fish Saadiyah Qureshi

The vibes we bring to the meeting 💻

Feryal Nawaz Manuel Silva-Paulus Harrison Lazarus Nicolet Hartmann Wyatt Wu Adisa Duke Justin M. Harris

The assignment: Interview Oprah 🫡 

A little BTS of one of the coolest days of my career!!!

I helped create Forbes' highest-performing organic Instagram post of the year! 👇🏼

Since our team publishes some of the best journalism in the world, I'm constantly thinking about how we can package it in a way that feels native to social.

When we were getting ready to launch our first-ever Highest-Paid Podcasters list, it felt like the perfect opportunity to experiment. Podcasting is having such a cultural moment that we knew the topic would resonate. The question became: how do we showcase it in a way that people actually want to consume and share?

My team and I pulled inspo from the kinds of posts that constantly catch our attention, which are bold, easy to scan, and tell you exactly what you want to know without making you dig for it.

So I worked with our incredibly talented design team to rethink the launch. We skipped the traditional intro cover slide, led with the title & data immediately, made the earnings impossible to miss, and introduced a more colorful look that broke away from our black and red aesthetic.

And it became the highest-performing! 4.2M+ impressions, 98K+ engagements. Subtle win  🎉

One of my favorite things about the creator economy is how much of it is built on community 💓

Spent yesterday at Creator Economy Live in NYC, and it was one of those days where I realized just how many incredible people I’ve met and friendships I’ve built while being in this space.

Honorable mention: winning the airpods raffle (which I totally manifested) & cheering on my LinkedIn fam Sharon as she took the stage ✨
